title: SEEM Geo — Professional ERT & MASW Processing Suite
description: A Python package for processing field-acquired Electrical Resistivity Tomography (Wenner-alpha) and Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves data. Features: Occam 2D inversion, Vs30 computation, site classification, 8-correlation framework with full statistical qualifications, fence diagrams, Google Earth KMZ export, interactive dispersion picker, and ready-to-publish 58-page PDF reports.
notes: Open-source geophysical processing suite for linear-infrastructure site investigations.
